categories.main_business_segments: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China (AMEC) primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment including plasma etching equipment, thin film deposition equipment, and MOCVD equipment. The company also develops equipment for integrated circuits, advanced packaging, LED epitaxial wafer production, power devices, MEMS, and other microfabrication processes. Additionally, it operates subsidiaries focusing on semiconductor equipment manufacturing, digital industrial internet platforms, and environmental purification equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AMEC's core technologies include advanced plasma etching (CCP and ICP), thin film chemical vapor deposition (CVD, LPCVD, ALD), and metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) for compound semiconductors. The company emphasizes proprietary dual-chamber designs, adjustable electrode spacing, and ultra-high aspect ratio etching capabilities. It employs a matrix management R&D model with specialized teams for mechanical design, process development, and software engineering. The company also capitalizes development costs upon meeting strict criteria and maintains a strong patent portfolio.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are semiconductor manufacturers producing integrated circuits, LED epitaxial wafers, power devices, MEMS, and advanced packaging products. Key markets include logic chip fabrication (down to 5nm and below), 3D NAND and DRAM memory production, high-end LED displays (Mini-LED, Micro-LED), power semiconductor devices (GaN, SiC), and MEMS devices. Customers are mainly leading domestic and international semiconductor fabs and related high-tech enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: AMEC operates primarily in China, with major production and R&D bases in Shanghai (including Pudong New Area and Lingang), Nanchang, Guangzhou, and Chengdu. It also has subsidiaries and sales offices in Singapore, Japan, South Korea, and the United States, serving global customers. The company’s revenue is predominantly from mainland China, with growing international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: AMEC operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying critical semiconductor fabrication equipment. It provides key processing tools such as etching and deposition machines essential for wafer fabrication and device manufacturing. The company also invests in upstream supply chain localization and collaborates closely with component suppliers to ensure quality and supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-intensity R&D investment, dedicating over 27% of revenue to research and development, focusing on advanced etching, thin film deposition, and MOCVD technologies. It aims to close the gap with international leaders by developing equipment for advanced logic nodes (5nm and below), ultra-high aspect ratio memory etching, and third-generation semiconductor power devices (GaN and SiC). AMEC also expands into metrology and inspection equipment and digital industrial internet platforms, while fostering innovation culture and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: AMEC generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including etching machines, MOCVD systems, and thin film deposition tools. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts, equipment-related services, and technical support. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by agents in certain regions and follows an order-based production approach with some inventory production for common components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AMEC is positioned as a leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturer with growing international presence. It competes with established global players from the US, Europe, and Japan, particularly in plasma etching and MOCVD equipment markets. The company holds a significant market share in China and is recognized as a top supplier in GaN-based LED MOCVD equipment globally. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, strong R&D capabilities, and close customer collaboration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, AMEC reported revenue of approximately RMB 9.07 billion, a 44.73% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.62 billion. The company has shown rapid growth in etching equipment sales (up 54.72%) and has significantly increased R&D spending by 94.31% to RMB 2.45 billion. Total assets reached RMB 26.22 billion, up 21.8% from the previous year, reflecting expansion in production capacity and R&D infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AMEC emphasizes technological innovation, product differentiation, and intellectual property protection to deliver high-performance, reliable semiconductor fabrication equipment. Its products support advanced manufacturing processes including ultra-high aspect ratio etching and multi-template lithography, critical for next-generation chips. The company offers customized solutions, rapid technical support, and close collaboration with customers, enabling improved production efficiency and cost reduction. Its dual-chamber designs and adjustable plasma technologies provide superior process control and yield advantages.
